aditya: onboarding Halley-13B int4 (quantize_v2). seeing consistent summarization drop vs fp16: rouge-L 35.2 -> 30.7. any ideas?
marta: share eval command + tokenizer and a tiny repro prompt pls.
aditya: eval command: python tools/eval_chat.py --model=halley-13b-int4 --tokenizer=halley-tok-v1 --task=summarize --batch=8 --max_len=1024. conversion output had warnings: WARN token_map: pad 1 -> 0 (remapped); WARN rotary_freq: saved_scale 1.0 current_scale 0.99994
ryan: top suspects: rotary frequency/scale mismatch, token id remap affecting kv-cache warmup, or attention-proj layout change after quant. did you try disabling kv warmup?
aditya: quick checks: int4 baseline rouge-L 30.7; int4 --kv_warmup=false -> 33.9; int4 --kv_warmup=false --rotary_scale=1.0 -> 34.8. reproducible across seeds.
samantha: strong signal. looks like kv_warmup + token_map remap amplifies quant noise. i'll add a runtime guard to skip kv_warmup when token_map.remapped == true and emit a warning; will open a PR with tests.
marta: i'll bisect the conversion script to find where pad remap originates. aditya, paste conversion tool version and repro prompt to the ticket.
aditya: gist with repro + logs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/halley-int4-repro. conversion tool v2.3.1.
ci-bot: Created issue RED-ML-842: "Halley-13B int4: pad-remap + kv_warmup -> summarization regression" (assignee: marta).
aditya: disabling int4 for Halley on hosted until we have a fix. tagging @marta @samantha
